title: Department of Rural Development Centre
text:
The centre was established in 1975 with a strong foot in the rural Indian perspective covering district-based regional development schemes in many areas like Intensive Crop Farming, Forestry, Horticulture, NTFP-based crafts, Women and Child Welfare programmes etc. The infrastructure includes Chemical & Bio-chemical Laboratory, Repair & Fabrication Shop, Experimental Farm & Medicinal Plant Nursery, Field Station & Crafts Training Centres at Kharikamathani and Khariduara Mushroom?Shed & Apiary Unit The sponsored projects undertaken by the centre include Participatory Forest Management Project, Tribal Development Project, Integrated Rural Energy Planning, Agro-Climatic Regional Planning, A Study in Search of an Alternative Source of Vegetable Oil. 

Prof. Virendra Kumar Tewari is the current Head of the Centre.

 Research Areas 

* Agricultural Production and Management
* Agri Value Chain Financing & Management
* Education, Health and Water Management
* Ethnographic and Qualitative Research
* Green Urban Planning, Biodiversity & Eco
* Pricing & Risk management in Agriculture
* Rural Development and Regional Planning
* Small and Medium Enterprises Financing
* Social Forestry
* Water Resource Economics

 Research Laboratories 

* Chemical And Biochemical Laboratory
* Mechanical Fabrication Lab
* Rural Technology Demonstration Laboratory
